test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: When is World Migratory Bird Day celebrated every year?

options.text: First Sunday of April and November
Second Saturday of May and October
Second Saturday of April and November
First Sunday of May and October

solution:
The correct answer is __**Second Saturday of May and October.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• World Migratory Bird Day (WMBD) is observed on the second Saturday in May and the second Saturday in October.
 
• The day began in 2006 by the United Nations (UN).
 
• For 2022, it is being observed on May 14 and October 8.
 
• The day raises awareness about the problems that migratory birds face.
 
• “Impact of Light Pollution on Migratory Birds" is the theme of the campaign for 2022.
